sections.title: Welcome to the Quest
sections.text: Explore the platform through guided tours and unlock new levels as you earn points.

sections.title: Play to Learn
sections.text: Each level combines an interactive tour with a short quiz. Pass the quiz to advance.

sections.title: Stay in Control
sections.text: Track your progress and unlock new missions after the cool-down period.

welcome.title: Dashboard Quest
welcome.subtitle: Level 1 · Starter Mission
welcome.description: Get acquainted with your mgSCALE dashboard — your control center for KPIs, live alerts, and shipment tracking at a glance.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the core dashboard. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Dashboard Mastered!
completion.message: You navigated the dashboard with confidence. KPIs, alerts, and shipments are no longer a mystery.

welcome.title: Control Tower Quest
welcome.subtitle: Level 2 · Operations Mission
welcome.description: Step into the Control Tower to monitor branch operations, manage pending actions, and oversee logistics lanes in real time.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the Control Tower. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Control Tower Cleared!
completion.message: You can now monitor live operations and respond to actions from the Control Tower like a pro.

welcome.title: Cryocan Quality Tracking
welcome.subtitle: Level 3 · Branch Mission
welcome.description: Zoom into individual branch performance. Learn to filter, compare, and act on branch-level data to keep every location running smoothly.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored branch-level data. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Branch Expert!
completion.message: You can drill into any branch and read its performance snapshot at a glance. Branch data holds no secrets for you.

welcome.title: Alert Configuration
welcome.subtitle: Level 4 · Alert Mission
welcome.description: Set up and fine-tune alert thresholds so your clinic never misses a critical LN2 event. Stay one step ahead of every warning.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the alert settings. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Alerts Configured!
completion.message: Your clinic's alert system is now fully under your control. Every critical event will reach the right person at the right time.

welcome.title: Refill Log
welcome.subtitle: Level 5 · Supply Mission
welcome.description: Track every LN2 refill event — who performed it, when, and how much was added. Keep your supply chain fully transparent.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the Refill Log. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Supply Chain Visible!
completion.message: You can now trace every refill event and maintain a complete, auditable view of your LN2 supply.

welcome.title: Reports
welcome.subtitle: Level 6 · Insights Mission
welcome.description: Unlock the power of reporting — filter activity logs, download data exports, and review your clinic's full operational history.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the Reports section. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Reports Unlocked!
completion.message: You can now generate, filter, and analyze reports to make smarter, data-driven decisions for your clinic.

welcome.title: Profile
welcome.subtitle: Level 7 · Identity Mission
welcome.description: Manage your personal information, review your support ticket history, and configure your notification preferences all in one place.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored your Profile. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Profile Complete!
completion.message: Your account is fully configured. You know exactly where to update your info, track support, and manage notifications.

welcome.title: Users
welcome.subtitle: Level 8 · Admin Mission
welcome.description: Manage your clinic's user roster — filter by role and branch, invite new members, and control who has access to your mgSCALE account.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the Users page. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: You're Certified!
completion.message: You've completed all 8 levels of mgSCALE onboarding. From monitoring tanks and managing alerts to running reports and controlling user access — you're ready to run your clinic at full power.
